title.zh: 恒星为何发光，表面为何会活动？
title.en: Why stars shine and why their surfaces change

context.zh: 以太阳为例 · 从核心到外层
context.en: THE SUN AS AN EXAMPLE · CORE TO ATMOSPHERE

scale.zh: 左侧 A 圈定右图的同一处光球；固定太阳朝向让选区始终可见。两图的黑子位置共用同一活动区，局部层厚、形状与倍率仍是机制示意。暖色箭头表示热物质上升，蓝色表示冷却后下沉；折线和亮点表示辐射反复传递。核心聚变持续供能，耀斑只短时释放磁能；颜色、速度及尺度不能按图测量。
scale.en: Circle A selects the same photospheric region shown on the right. A held solar orientation keeps it visible. Both views share the active-region positions; local thicknesses, shapes and magnification remain mechanism illustrations. Warm arrows show hot material rising and blue arrows show its cooler return; bent lines and light dots show repeated radiative transfer. Core fusion supplies sustained energy, while a flare briefly releases magnetic energy. Colors, speeds and sizes are not measurements.

section.zh: 同一颗太阳 · 外观与剖面

surface.zh: 同一处光球 · 局部放大

wind.zh: 太阳风 · 日冕物质流出

selectedRegion.en: A: the photospheric region enlarged at right

radiationKey.zh: 折线与亮点：辐射反复传递
radiationKey.en: Bent paths + light dots: repeated radiative transfer

convectionKey.zh: 暖 ↑ 热物质上升 · 蓝 ↓ 冷却下沉
convectionKey.en: Warm ↑ hot material rises · blue ↓ cooler return

fieldKey.zh: ＋/−：相反磁极 · 曲线：磁连接示意

flareProgress.en: This flare: drag to compare before and after

flareNote.zh: 一次事件结束后不循环；“暂停动态”同时固定传能和表面活动。拖动会暂停，可在减少动态时逐步对照；这是观察进度，不是真实耀斑时长。
flareNote.en: One event ends without looping. Pause motion holds transport and surface activity together. Seeking pauses it, so reduced-motion readers can compare stages directly. This is observation progress, not a real flare duration.

stored.zh: 前态：磁场储存能量，尚无耀斑
stored.en: Before: magnetic energy is stored; no flare yet

reconnecting.zh: 连接改变：两组磁场在局部重联
reconnecting.en: Connections change: the field bundles reconnect locally

release.zh: 短时释放：局部加热、发光
release.en: Brief release: local heating and radiation

fading.zh: 衰减：辐射减弱，新的磁连接留下
fading.en: Fading: radiation weakens; new connections remain

after.zh: 后态：耀斑结束，磁连接已改变
after.en: After: the flare has ended and connections have changed

body.zh: 引力把氢等离子体压到很热、很密。核心把氢聚变成氦，一部分质量转成能量；这持续供给恒星的光和热，不是氧气燃烧。
body.en: Gravity compresses hydrogen-rich plasma to high temperature and density. Core fusion makes helium, converting some mass into energy. This powers long-term starlight and heat, not oxygen-based burning.

boundary.zh: 图中的亮点不是单个核反应的实拍，也没有计算反应速率。
boundary.en: The glow is not a photograph of nuclear reactions and does not calculate their rate.

body.zh: 先找辐射区的折线和亮点：能量经反复吸收、再发射传递。再找外圈暖色上升、蓝色返回的对流；右图把这种升降接到光球的亮颗粒和暗间隙。不是一束光从核心直线冲到表面。
body.en: First find bent paths and light dots in the radiative zone: energy is repeatedly absorbed and re-emitted. Then find warm rising material and its blue return in the outer convection zone. The right view connects that circulation to bright photospheric granules and dark lanes. One photon does not fly straight from core to surface.

boundary.zh: 折线、箭头和亮点是机制编码，不是单个光子或等离子体的实测轨迹，也不代表传播速度或对流单元大小。
boundary.en: Bent paths, arrows and light dots encode mechanisms, not measured photon or plasma trajectories, speeds or cell sizes.

observe.zh: 辐射折线 → 成对升降 → 光球颗粒

body.zh: 我们看到的可见表面是光球，不是固体壳。对流抵达这里，形成较亮的颗粒和较暗的颗粒间隙；上方细小喷流属于外层大气的示意，不能把表面看成笔直的地平线。
body.en: The visible surface is the photosphere, not a solid shell. Convection makes brighter granules and darker lanes between them. Fine jets above belong to the outer atmosphere; the surface is not a rigid straight horizon.

boundary.zh: 右图是局部放大示意，颗粒、间隙与喷流的大小及速度均未经观测标定。
boundary.en: The patch is enlarged; sizes and speeds of cells, lanes and jets are not calibrated to observations.

observe.en: Granules, dark lanes and fine jets

body.zh: 穿出光球的强磁场抑制局部对流，区域比周围稍冷，因此显暗。黑子不是太阳表面破了洞，也不代表核心聚变停止。
body.en: Strong magnetic fields emerging through the photosphere suppress local convection. These areas are somewhat cooler and look dark. Sunspots are neither holes nor a shutdown of core fusion.

boundary.zh: 磁力线和黑子位置用于解释关系；这里没有求解太阳磁流体方程。
boundary.en: Field lines and spot positions explain the relationship; no solar magnetohydrodynamics is solved here.

body.zh: 仍在选区 A。先看两组磁场的连接，再看局部重联后连接关系改变，储存的磁能短时释放；亮光随后衰减，新的连接留下。拖动可对照前后，也能重看一次。耀斑不是持续的太阳风。
body.en: Stay in region A. Compare two bundles of field connections, then their changed connections after local reconnection releases stored magnetic energy. The flash fades while the new connections remain. Seek to compare before and after or replay once. A flare is not the steady solar wind.

boundary.zh: 磁极、曲线和连接变化是拓扑机制示意，不是求解磁流体方程；亮度、形状和观察进度均不按一次真实耀斑计算。
boundary.en: Polarity, curves and changing connections are a topology sketch, not a magnetohydrodynamic solution. Brightness, shape and observation progress are not calibrated to a real flare.

observe.zh: 同一活动区：前态 → 重联 → 释放 → 后态
observe.en: One region: before → reconnection → release → after

body.zh: 日冕是稀薄的外层大气。一部分带电粒子持续向外流，成为太阳风；其他恒星也可能有恒星风，但强弱和机制细节不全相同。
body.en: The corona is the thin outer atmosphere. Some charged particles continually stream outward as solar wind. Other stars can have stellar winds, but their strengths and details differ.

boundary.zh: 小点展示向外流的方向，不代表单个粒子的真实速度或密度；没有把耀斑误画成恒星风的唯一来源。
boundary.en: Dots show outward flow, not true individual speeds or density; the flare is not presented as the wind's sole source.
